content: We offer Web Hosting plans suitable for personal websites, blogs, and small businesses. All plans include cPanel control panel, one-click installers (WordPress, Joomla, etc.), free SSL certificates, and 24/7 support. Contact us or visit the client portal for current pricing.

Our Reseller Hosting plans allow you to host multiple clients under your own brand. Features include WHM control panel, WHMCS billing integration, private nameservers, and scalable disk/bandwidth allocations. Ideal for web agencies and entrepreneurs.

VPS (Virtual Private Server) Hosting provides dedicated resources with full root access. Our VPS plans are suitable for high-traffic websites, custom applications, and developer environments. Management options include both managed and unmanaged configurations.

Dedicated Servers give you an entire physical machine exclusively for your use. Perfect for large e-commerce stores, high-performance applications, and clients requiring maximum isolation and resources. Custom hardware configurations are available on request.

topic: Difference Between Shared, VPS, and Dedicated Hosting
content: Shared Hosting (Web Hosting) shares server resources with other customers — it is the most affordable option. VPS Hosting gives you a dedicated slice of a server with guaranteed resources. Dedicated Hosting means the entire server is yours. The choice depends on your traffic, performance needs, and budget.
Log in to the client portal, go to Services, select your active service, and click Upgrade/Downgrade. The cost difference is prorated automatically. If you need help, open a support ticket.
We guarantee 99.9% server uptime monthly across all hosting services. Downtime caused by scheduled maintenance windows or events outside our control (force majeure) is excluded from SLA calculations.

All hosting plans include free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates. SSL is automatically provisioned and renewed. You can also install a custom/premium SSL certificate through the cPanel SSL/TLS manager or contact support for assistance.

Web and Reseller Hosting plans use cPanel as the control panel. VPS and Dedicated Server customers can request cPanel/WHM installation or use their preferred control panel. Login details are sent to your registered email upon account activation.

Bandwidth and disk usage limits vary by plan. You can monitor usage in real-time through cPanel. If you are approaching your limits, we recommend upgrading your plan. Overage charges may apply depending on your plan terms.
